_doc: Director-authored cue list. 'variants' is filled by the director after auditions (sfx_lab build output paths); until then 'fallback' (existing assets) plays. volume_db is the playback offset after loudness-normalised assets; pitch_jitter is ± fraction; cooldown_ms suppresses repeats of the same cue; max_voices caps simultaneous instances; 'trigger' documents exactly when it plays.

rules.one_impact_per_hit: A damaging hit plays exactly one impact cue (by attack kind) plus at most one body/hurt layer. Never stack two impacts for one hit.
rules.area_hits: An area or multi-target action plays its impact once at full volume and up to 2 more instances at -6 dB staggered 35 ms.

swing.light.trigger: Wind-up of a light melee attack (blade/claw/pierce, damage <= 5), timed to the weapon's swing start.

swing.heavy.trigger: Wind-up of a heavy melee attack (blunt, or any melee with damage >= 6).

hit.blade.light.trigger: Contact of a blade attack (sword, dagger, rapier, axe, halberd, scythe, glass spear edge) dealing <= 5 damage.

hit.blade.heavy.trigger: Contact of a blade attack dealing >= 6.

hit.blunt.light.trigger: Contact of a blunt attack (mace, maul, club, fist, shield bash, body slam, stone fist) dealing <= 5.

hit.blunt.heavy.trigger: Contact of a blunt attack dealing >= 6.

hit.pierce.trigger: Contact of a thrust or projectile: spear, lance, arrow, bolt, dart, bone spike.

hit.claw.trigger: Contact of claws, bites, rakes and tails.

hit.blocked.trigger: Replaces the impact when a hit is fully absorbed by Block or Stoneskin (no HP lost).

block.break.trigger: Plays with the impact when a hit removes the last of a unit's Block (and HP is lost).

block.gain.trigger: A unit gains Block from a card or intent.

hurt.hero.trigger: Body layer when the hero loses >= 5 HP from one hit (cloth/leather and a low body thud; no voice).

shot.bow.trigger: Release of a bow or sling shot (hero or enemy).

shot.crossbow.trigger: Release of a crossbow bolt or thrown weapon.

cast.arcane.trigger: Launch of a neutral spell (Pale Spark, Dull Bolt, Waning Pulse, acolyte bolts).

spell.lightning.trigger: Lightning spell/attack impact, including chain hops (chain hops at -5 dB).

spell.shadow.trigger: Umbra/shadow attacks (Noctyrax, Veilbound, wick shades) and Eclipse effects.

death.beast.trigger: Death start: crawler, ash hound, rime whelp, stoneback mite, crawler-like beasts.

death.humanoid.trigger: Death start: acolyte, grave surgeon, lancer, gaoler, bell tender, lamplighter, cantor (body fall + cloth/metal, no scream).

death.bone.trigger: Death start: bone harrier and skeletal foes (bones clattering).

death.stone.trigger: Death start: stone warden, craghide, shale bloomer (stone crumble).

death.ooze.trigger: Death start: cinder ooze, droplets, bile bloomer (wet collapse; cinder variants hiss).

death.spirit.trigger: Death start: lightning wisp, wick shade, veilbound acolyte (airy dissipating whoosh).

death.avian.trigger: Death start: gallows roc, roc fledglings.

vocal.beast.trigger: 30% chance at a beast/avian enemy's attack wind-up; never two vocals within 900 ms.

dragon.roar.trigger: A dragon's first action each fight and each time it starts a big area attack (warnings resolve).

step.hero.trigger: Each tile the hero walks (synced to the walk cycle).

step.enemy.light.trigger: Each tile a small/medium enemy walks.

step.enemy.heavy.trigger: Each tile a large enemy (warden, craghide, guardians, dragons) walks.

push.slide.trigger: A unit is pushed or pulled (stone scrape, length-matched).

push.collision.trigger: A pushed unit slams into a unit, wall or obstacle (replaces the impact for collision damage).

trap.trigger.trigger: A trap springs (mechanism click), followed by its element's spell cue.

status.shatter.trigger: A frozen unit takes the triple-damage hit (ice shatter replaces the impact).

radiance.light.trigger: Vision/Light/Truesight/Dispel Umbra effects (low warm swell, not a chime).

heal.trigger: Any heal on the hero or an enemy.

illusion.break.trigger: An illusion is destroyed or dispelled (glassy dissipate).

crate.break.trigger: A box or crate is destroyed.

crate.hit.trigger: A box or crate is damaged but survives.

pickup.item.trigger: The hero picks up a consumable or vial on the board.

pickup.gear.trigger: The hero picks up dropped gear.

death.hero.trigger: The hero falls (before the death overlay).

defiance.trigger: A Defiance charge saves the hero from a lethal hit (heartbeat + rise).

relic.trigger.trigger: A relic's effect fires (with its HUD badge pulse).

card.hover.trigger: Pointer/focus enters a hand card (not during drag).

card.select.trigger: A card is selected/picked up for aiming.

card.invalid.trigger: An unplayable card or illegal target is chosen.

deck.shuffle.trigger: Discard reshuffles into the draw pile.

map.hover.trigger: Pointer/focus enters an available map room.

map.select.trigger: A map room is committed (replaces the generic click there).

event.choose.trigger: An event choice is committed (replaces the generic click there).

ambience.stone.trigger: Room ambience bed, stone biome (today's hall tone).

ambience.tharokh.trigger: Room ambience bed in Tharokh's section: cave drips, distant earth groans.

ambience.vyraketh.trigger: Vyraketh's section: low fire roar, embers crackling.

ambience.vaeloryx.trigger: Vaeloryx's section: hollow wind through stone.

ambience.iskaldra.trigger: Iskaldra's section: cold wind and ice creaks.

ambience.zekarion.trigger: Zekarion's section: distant thunder and charged hum.

ambience.noctyrax.trigger: Noctyrax's section: low umbral drone and faint whispers.
